description: The alphabetical tie-break was removed, so tags used equally often come out in insertion order.
report_specific: popular_tags returns the wrong order when two tags are used the same number of times. With 'backend' and 'docs' both used twice, the result is ['docs', 'backend'], but ties should be listed alphabetically: ['backend', 'docs'].
report_vague: The tag suggestions list seems to shuffle: tags that are used equally often appear in an order that looks random and depends on how the tasks were added.
